Container.Name: MCP-SSH-Server
Container.Overview: TypeScript MCP server that securely executes arbitrary commands on remote hosts via SSH.

Config.Name: Host Port
Config.Description: The external port mapping for the MCP SSE interface.

Config.Name: Doppler Token
Config.Description: Doppler Service Token to fetch KNOWN_HOSTS_B64 and dynamic SSH keys.

Config.Name: MCP API Key
Config.Description: A secure, static Bearer token used by MCP clients to authenticate. You can generate one via terminal: openssl rand -hex 32
